A portfolio of applied machine learning and deep learning work, built in Python with Jupyter notebooks.

[View source on GitHub](https://github.com/laurasalop03/applied-ml-and-deep-learning){.btn .btn-outline-secondary}

## What it covers

- **Predictive regression**: building and evaluating models that predict a continuous target.
- **Computer vision autoencoders**: learning compressed representations of images.
- **Optimized neural networks**: training and tuning networks for better performance.

## Why it is relevant to quant work

The same supervised and representation learning methods transfer directly to quantitative finance: return prediction, feature construction from raw market data, and anomaly detection.

## Tech

Python, Jupyter, standard ML and DL libraries.
